items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: I didn’t know Al Grey real good

ctx.x: I didn’t know Al Grey real good, but he kind of played like J.J. and me. Kind of had a skill to play a laughable kind of a trombone. You know he would play like [scats] with the wah-wah. I never learned how to do that either. But he played the horn in a humorous kind of a way. You know?
